name: Emilia Dean
life: “I still remember the careful slant of my mum's newly married signature.” On Thursday, near Paper & Pine Books, Emilia starts with the handwritten shelf cards and often leaves with a suggestion for somebody else.
voice: My mother signed the slip. It's the earliest sample I've seen of the married name she later gave up.
appearance: Emilia has a loose dark braid, a long face and high cheekbones, and a favorite piece of clothing, a dark green knitted vest. It usually goes with a folded shopping list secured by a miniature clip. When somebody else has the floor, Emilia draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first.
personality: Emilia has a long memory for unfair prices and a short one for small insults. Emilia can get along perfectly well with an enemy provided the account between them is clear.
agenda: To keep a copy of the mother's old signature.
family: Billie Hunt is Emilia’s cousin. Emilia saves a place. Billie chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The empty chair on nights*, Billie says, “I know why she left. It's her marriage and her choice to tell the ward if she wants.”
connections: Martin Arrieta (school conservator). The repair paste helps date a signature in a newly adopted surname.
